```yaml name: Social Copy Generator on: pull_request: types: [opened] jobs: post-social-copy-comment: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Checkout repository uses: actions/checkout@v2 - name: Set up Node.js uses: actions/setup-node@v2 with: node-version: '14' - name: Install dependencies run: npm install - name: Create social copy comment id: create_comment uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa with: github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} message: |
Generate social media copies

Check this box to generate Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and Blog Post content.

regenerate-social-copy-comment: needs: post-social-copy-comment runs-on: ubuntu-latest if: github.event.pull_request.head.sha != github.event.pull_request.base.sha steps: - name: Checkout repository uses: actions/checkout@v2 - name: Set up Node.js uses: actions/setup-node@v2 with: node-version: '14' - name: Install dependencies run: npm install - name: Regenerate social copy comment id: regenerate_comment uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa with: github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} message: |
Generate social media copies

Check this box to generate Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and Blog Post content.

```
